desc.en: A spirit of grass. It dwells among hardy weeds that grow even in ruined lands. They are relatively large in number compared to other spirits. They are hostile to alchemists, since they gather grass and other plants.
desc.ja: 草の精霊。荒れ果てた大地にたくましく育つ雑草類に宿る。数は他の精霊に比べても比較的多い。採取などで草を採ってしまうため錬金術士には敵対的
